why: A is lemma_7_3_3 at universe 0: for every ep-groupoid X (Obj Mor : Type) and z ∈ |X| there is V : ℕ → Set |X| with every V k open and containing z and (𝓝 z).HasAntitoneBasis V. B: open V k, z ∈ V (k+1) ⊆ V k, and (𝓝 z).HasBasis (fun _ ↦ True) V (index shift ℕ from 0 instead of 1).
